remarks:
Welcome to 328 Jewett Avenue, a fantastic opportunity to own a spacious and income-producing two-family home in the heart of Buffalo's University District. Whether you're an investor seeking strong cash flow or an owner-occupant looking to offset your mortgage with rental income, this property offers the perfect combination of space, convenience, and potential.
This multi-family property features two generously sized apartments, each offering comfortable living spaces, spacious bedrooms, functional layouts, and plenty of natural light. Separate utilities provide added convenience and lower operating costs, making this an attractive investment for landlords and tenants alike. A full basement offers abundant storage space and additional functionality, while the property's solid mechanical systems contribute to long-term peace of mind.
Ideally located just minutes from the University at Buffalo South Campus, Buffalo VA Medical Center, public transportation, shopping centers, restaurants, parks, and major highways, this property enjoys strong rental demand year-round. The convenient location makes commuting easy while providing access to everything Buffalo has to offer.
Whether you're looking to expand your investment portfolio, generate passive income, or live in one unit while renting the other, 328 Jewett Ave presents endless possibilities, this is a property you don't want to miss!
